pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the apostrophe for in xīngqī'èr? (1 mark)
   A. To show a question
   B. To show a capital
   C. To show a tone
   D. To separate the syllables qī and èr

2. What is the full stop in Chinese? (1 mark)
   A. ,
   B. 。
   C. 、
   D. ?

3. Which Chinese word means "four"? (1 mark)
   A. 一 yī
   B. 十 shí
   C. 九 jiǔ
   D. 四 sì

4. Which sentence means "I use my ears to hear."? (1 mark)
   A. 我有两只眼睛。
   B. 我用嘴巴说。
   C. 我用耳朵听。
   D. 我用眼睛看。

5. Fill the blank: 我家有五____人。 (There are five people in my family.) (1 mark)
   A. 号
   B. 两
   C. 只
   D. 口

6. Which sentence means "The garden is on the right of the house."? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在哪儿?
   B. 床在卧室。
   C. 电视在哪儿?
   D. 花园在房子右边。

7. What does 生日 (shēngrì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cake
   B. Happy
   C. To come
   D. Birthday

8. What does 明天 (míngtiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. To go
   C. Mosque
   D. To rest

9. What does 四 (sì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Three
   C. Six
   D. Nine

10. Which Chinese word means "church"? (1 mark)
   A. 昨天 zuótiān
   B. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   C. 去 qù
   D. 教堂 jiàotáng

11. Which character has an extra dot compared with 大? (1 mark)
   A. 入
   B. 天
   C. 太
   D. 人

12. Which room would you find a fridge in? (1 mark)
   A. 厨房 the kitchen
   B. 厕所 the toilet
   C. 卧室 the bedroom
   D. 客厅 the living room

13. Which Chinese word means "what"? (1 mark)
   A. 肉 ròu
   B. 什么 shénme
   C. 水 shuǐ
   D. 葡萄 pútao

14. Read the pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. That is my younger brother.
   B. There are five people in my family.
   C. This is my father.
   D. Who is this?

15. Which sentence means "I use my mouth to speak."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用眼睛看。
   B. 我用嘴巴说。
   C. 我用耳朵听。
   D. 我有两只眼睛。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 来 and 笑. (2 marks)

17. Describe where three things are in a house using 在. Write the Chinese and the meaning. (4 marks)

18. Give three steps of good imitation when learning a new word. (3 marks)

19. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 风 and 鸡肉. (2 marks)

20. Explain why a healthy plate should have food from several groups and name two groups with their Chinese names. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — To separate the syllables qī and èr
   It marks where èr begins.

2. B — 。
   The Chinese full stop is a small circle.

3. D — 四 sì
   四 (sì) means four.

4. C — 我用耳朵听。
   我用耳朵听。 (wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.) means "I use my ears to hear.".

5. D — 口
   口 is used to count family members.

6. D — 花园在房子右边。
   花园在房子右边。 (huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.) means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

7. D — Birthday
   生日 (shēngrì) means birthday.

8. A — Tomorrow
   明天 (míngtiān) means tomorrow.

9. A — Four
   四 (sì) means four.

10. D — 教堂 jiàotáng
   教堂 (jiàotáng) means church.

11. C — 太
   太 is 大 with an extra dot.

12. A — 厨房 the kitchen
   冰箱 is in the kitchen, 厨房.

13. B — 什么 shénme
   什么 (shénme) means what.

14. B — There are five people in my family.
   wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. is 我家有五口人。, which means "There are five people in my family.".

15. B — 我用嘴巴说。
   我用嘴巴说。 (wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.) means "I use my mouth to speak.".

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 来: lái, to come. 笑: xiào, to laugh, to smile.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: 床在卧室 (the bed is in the bedroom); 冰箱在厨房 (the fridge is in the kitchen); 电视在客厅 (the television is in the living room).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meanings.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole word, repeat it slowly, compare with the speaker and correct.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风: fēng, wind. 鸡肉: jīròu, chicken (meat).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Each group does a different job. Vegetables and fruit (蔬菜, 水果) give vitamins, rice (米饭) gives energy, and meat (肉) helps the body grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 1 mark for each group named, 1 mark for the job.
